decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also utilizes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to control the board and protect its combo pieces. The inclusion of Leyline Binding allows for further disruption of the opponent's strategy. The deck is designed to surprise and overwhelm the opponent with unexpected plays and creative combos, relying on its unique synergy between cards to secure victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through the efficient use of UrzaTron lands and artifacts, allowing for ramping into powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus while creating a strong board presence with cards like Wurmcoil Engine and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana ramp for the deck. The overall strategy revolves around efficient resource management and powerful late game threats.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cast Cascade spells, particularly Crashing Footfalls, to overwhelm the opponent with multiple 4/4 Rhino tokens. The deck utilizes the Cascade mechanic to consistently put powerful spells into play for a low cost, allowing it to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game. Additionally, utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to trigger Cascade effects, while also having support from versatile spells like Dead/Gone, Fire/Ice, and Force of Negation to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Leyline Binding to control the board and protect its combo pieces. Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismari Command provide additional utility and disruption to the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and consistency in pulling off the combo. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through its unique and creative combo strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Cascade mechanic to quickly and efficiently cast free spells, such as Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and tempo control, using cards like Fury and Violent Outburst to apply pressure and maintain board presence. By combining aggressive creatures with impactful Cascade spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victories through a combination of speed and disruption.

This deck aims to assemble the powerful combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to create a fast and lethal threat. Using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid, the deck can efficiently tutor for and equip the Colossus Hammer, allowing for explosive attack potential. Additionally, the deck includes elements of protection and disruption, such as Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler, to help ensure the combo can go off without a hitch. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly equipping a massive threat and overwhelming the opponent before they can react.

This combo deck aims to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer equipment on creatures like Puresteel Paladin to create a lethal threat. Using Sigarda's Aid and Stoneforge Mystic to cheat out equipment, along with Inkmoth Nexus and Kor Outfitter for additional support, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offensive strategy. With a mix of protection cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, as well as card draw with Esper Sentinel, the goal is to establish a dominant board presence and win the game in a few swift turns.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on fast, efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent. With a mix of powerful threats like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate, the goal is to control the board while steadily building up a threatening board presence. The deck also features utility lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to provide additional options and flexibility in different game situations. The key strategy is to maintain a strong board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies through a combination of removal spells and hand disruption. It uses powerful cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Archon of Cruelty to control the board and generate card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth provide ramp and mana fixing to ensure a smooth curve. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by using efficient removal spells and disruptive threats to control the game and grind out a win.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells such as Crashing Footfalls and Fury for free. By playing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats. Key to the strategy is the use of cards like Dead / Gone and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and disrupt the opponent's gameplan. The deck's aggro nature combined with its cascade abilities makes it a fast and unpredictable force to be reckoned with in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping out powerful creatures and spells using cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. By chaining these cascades together, the deck can overwhelm opponents with a flurry of threats, supported by instant speed interaction like Force of Negation and Dead / Gone. The key strategy is to get Crashing Footfalls onto the battlefield for free, creating a massive board presence and quickly closing out the game. The deck also utilizes versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Fury to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach as a key card to facilitate powerful combos with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Unholy Heat. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard and generate card advantage while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Spell Pierce. By efficiently cycling through the deck and utilizing graveyard recursion, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage, removal, and aggressive threats.

The main concept of this Modern Dredge deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards using cards like Cathartic Reunion and Darkblast, in order to enable graveyard synergies such as Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam. This deck aims to bring back creatures from the graveyard, like Narcomoeba and Stinkweed Imp, to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The deck also utilizes cards like Otherworldly Gaze to help dig for key pieces and maintain its graveyard strategy. Ultimately, the goal is to outvalue and outpace the opponent through graveyard interactions and combo plays.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the synergy of UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate significant mana advantage. The deck aims to slow down the opponent with counterspells (Condescend, Remand), removal (Dismember, Engineered Explosives), and disruptive cards (Mindslaver, Nimble Obstructionist). It also includes powerful win conditions such as Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and Wurmcoil Engine. The combination of card advantage, control elements, and powerful threats make this deck a formidable force in the Modern format.

This Modern Aggro deck revolves around maximizing the power of Death's Shadow, a creature that gets stronger as your life total decreases. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Thoughtseize, and Drown in the Loch to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their strategy, while also generating card advantage with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck aims to play aggressively and efficiently, using its resources to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Indomitable Creativity and Dwarven Mine to cheat out big threats like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes cards like Transmogrify and Wrenn and Six to generate extra value and control the board. With access to powerful spells like Prismari Command and Lightning Bolt for disruption, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its creativity and combo potential. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect the combo and ensure its success.
